summary: CICS online Account Update screen -- the most complex online program. Lets a user retrieve an account, edit account and customer fields, and save the changes. It runs an extensive field-validation suite (account number, mandatory fields, yes/no flags, alphabetic, alphanumeric, numeric, signed amounts, US phone, SSN, US state code, FICO score, state+zip consistency), compares old vs new values, and only rewrites the account/customer records if something actually changed AND the record was not changed by someone else since it was read (optimistic concurrency check). Pseudo-conversational via a 2000-byte COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the update screen. On re-entry, evaluate the key (PF3 return to menu; Enter process inputs; PF5/other actions) and route via DECIDE-ACTION between: prompt for account, show fetched values, validate edits, or commit the update. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA and transaction id.

annotations.note: Pseudo-conversational state machine driving the read/edit/confirm/update lifecycle.

paragraphs.name: 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the map and run the full input-edit suite.

paragraphs.name: 1100-RECEIVE-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the account-update map from the terminal into the input fields.

paragraphs.name: 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate every editable field by calling the specific edit routines (account, mandatory, yes/no, alpha, alphanumeric, numeric, signed, phone, SSN, state, FICO, state+zip); accumulate an overall error flag.
branches: one call per field-type edit; set error flag if any fail

paragraphs.name: 1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW
paragraphs.pseudocode: Compare the newly entered values against the originally fetched values to determine whether the user actually changed anything.
branches: IF any field differs -> changes present

annotations.note: Change detection: no update is written if nothing changed.

paragraphs.name: 1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the account number is present, numeric and a valid 11-digit account id.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: account number must be present, numeric and 11 digits.

paragraphs.name: 1215-EDIT-MANDATORY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Ensure a mandatory field is not blank/low-values; error if missing.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: mandatory fields must be supplied.

paragraphs.name: 1220-EDIT-YESNO
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate a flag field is 'Y' or 'N' only.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: yes/no fields must be Y or N.

paragraphs.name: 1225-EDIT-ALPHA-REQD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate a required field contains only alphabetic characters (and spaces) and is non-blank.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: required alphabetic fields (e.g. names) must contain only letters.

paragraphs.name: 1230-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate a required field contains only alphanumeric characters and is non-blank.

paragraphs.name: 1235-EDIT-ALPHA-OPT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate an optional alphabetic field: if supplied it must contain only letters.

paragraphs.name: 1240-EDIT-ALPHANUM-OPT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate an optional alphanumeric field: if supplied it must be alphanumeric.

paragraphs.name: 1245-EDIT-NUM-REQD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate a required numeric field is present and numeric.

paragraphs.name: 1250-EDIT-SIGNED-9V2
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate a signed money field (9(n)V99): correct numeric format with optional sign and two decimals.
branches: IF not a valid signed decimal -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: monetary fields (limits, balances) must be valid signed amounts with two decimals.

paragraphs.name: 1260-EDIT-US-PHONE-NUM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate a US phone number by checking its area code, prefix and line-number components.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: US phone numbers must have a valid area code, prefix and line number.

paragraphs.name: EDIT-AREA-CODE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the phone area code is numeric and a recognized/valid area code.

paragraphs.name: EDIT-US-PHONE-PREFIX
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the phone prefix (exchange) is numeric and in range.

paragraphs.name: EDIT-US-PHONE-LINENUM
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the phone line number is numeric.

paragraphs.name: 1265-EDIT-US-SSN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate a US Social Security Number: 9 numeric digits with a valid area/group/serial (no all-zero groups).
branches: IF SSN not 9 digits / invalid parts -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: SSN must be 9 numeric digits with valid, non-zero area/group/serial parts.

paragraphs.name: 1270-EDIT-US-STATE-CD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the field is a recognized 2-character US state code.
branches: IF not a valid state code -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: state must be a valid US state code.

paragraphs.name: 1275-EDIT-FICO-SCORE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate the customer FICO credit score is numeric and within the valid range (300-850).

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: FICO score must be numeric and within 300-850 (confirm exact bounds with SME).

paragraphs.name: 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Validate that the ZIP code is consistent with the entered state (ZIP prefix matches the state).
branches: IF zip prefix not valid for state -> error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: ZIP code must be consistent with the US state.

paragraphs.name: 2000-DECIDE-ACTION
paragraphs.pseudocode: Decide the next step based on program state and whether edits passed: prompt for an account, display fetched data, ask the user to confirm changes, or perform the update.
branches: EVALUATE state: prompt / show / confirm / update

paragraphs.name: 3000-SEND-MAP
paragraphs.pseudocode: Build and send the account-update map: init, set variables (initial/original/updated values), info message, attributes, then transmit.

paragraphs.name: 3200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the map fields depending on state: initial (blank), original (as fetched) or updated (as edited) values.

paragraphs.name: 3300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS
paragraphs.pseudocode: Set field attributes: protect all fields, then unprotect the few that are editable in the current state; set the info-message attributes and cursor.

paragraphs.name: 9000-READ-ACCT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the account detail chain (cross-reference -> account -> customer) and store the fetched values as the 'original' baseline.

paragraphs.name: 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Save the freshly read account/customer values as the original baseline for later change comparison and concurrency checking.

paragraphs.name: 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING
paragraphs.pseudocode: Commit the update: re-read the record for update, verify it has not changed since it was displayed, and if unchanged rewrite the account and customer records with the edited values; otherwise report a concurrent-change error and abort the update.
branches: IF record changed since read -> concurrency error

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: the update is applied only if the record was not modified by another user since it was read (optimistic concurrency).

paragraphs.notes: BUSINESS-CRITICAL: the account/customer update with concurrency control.

paragraphs.name: 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC
paragraphs.pseudocode: Compare the just-re-read record against the baseline snapshot to detect whether another user changed it in the meantime.

annotations.note: Optimistic-locking check: detects concurrent modification before rewrite.

paragraphs.name: COMMON-RETURN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Save state to the COMMAREA and CICS RETURN with the transaction id (pseudo-conversational).

paragraphs.name: ABEND-ROUTINE
paragraphs.pseudocode: On an unrecoverable error, display an abend message and terminate the transaction.
